name: voxpilot-ai
description: Demo-first AI voice agent studio with browser speech, agent management and call analytics.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @voxpilot/api" "npm run dev -w @voxpilot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @voxpilot/api && npm run build -w @voxpilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @voxpilot/api && npm run typecheck -w @voxpilot/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @voxpilot/api && npm run lint -w @voxpilot/web
